method: Batch 90. Same double, row layout and record fields as village-fight-b87-reference.json plus `mathRandom` (as b39). Mobs VVG (two villagers, an iron golem) and the probe player; op `3 spawnspider 58.5 60.5 0 90` builds a spider (World.rand rolls the 1-in-100 skeleton jockey; the seeds are chosen so it hits) inside a 4-block stone ring (y 0 to 2, x/z 64 to 68) that the spider climbs (isCollidedHorizontally, 0.2 up) and its rider (a skeleton) shoots from. Executed: the arrow that hits the jockey itself sets the rider revenge target to itself while EntityAITarget.isSuitableTarget (self excluded) keeps its attack target on the player.
